title: Mitchell Tenpenny
description: Mitchell Tenpenny has captured fans everywhere with his husky voice, memorable hooks, and honest storytelling. With multiple No. 1 hits, including “Drunk Me,” “Truth About You,” and “At The End of a Bar,” and over 2.1 billion global streams, he’s established himself as a major force in country music. He continues to evolve his sound with recent albums like The 3rd, inviting listeners into his personal stories and musical journey. \n

title: A Man Named Cash
description: A Man Named Cash is the premier tribute to the music and lives of Johnny Cash and June Carter Cash. Featuring Eric Hofmanis, the only vocalist chosen by The Johnny Cash Estate to lead a concert experience tour celebrating Cash’s legacy, and Megan Houde as June Carter, the show brings nearly 50 years of Cash’s legendary music to life, performing timeless songs like “I Walk The Line,” “Folsom Prison Blues,” “Ring of Fire,” “Man in Black,” and “Hurt.” \n

description: Don’t miss this outrageous concert experience featuring your favorite artists from the 60s and 70s: The Association, The Troggs, Chicago lead singer (1985–2016) Jason Scheff, Gary Puckett, The Fortunes, Ron Dante from The Archies and The Turtles, The Vogues, and The Cowsills. title: Wabash Kiwanis Trivia Fundraiser for Riley Children’s Health
description:
Who? Wabash Kiwanis Club 
What? Trivia Fundraiser for Riley Children's Health 
When? Friday, August 28; Doors open at 6:30P; Event at 7:30P 
Where? Wabash Elks Lodge (NW corner of Market and Cass streets) 
How? Registration will take place closer to the date 
Why? To support Kiwanis’ and Riley’s missions for kids 
• Guests must be 18 years or older to attend 
• 8 rounds of 10 questions 
• Drinks and food available at Wabash Elks Lodge 
• A part of Wabash Founders Festival weekend
